finding: The Python entrypoint accepts any --binary path. It records production source and binary hashes only after integration. Rust BIND compares caller-supplied identity strings and does not read files or prove that the executable was built from the recorded source.
impact: A protocol-compatible stale executable can be run and then labeled SourceBoundConditional even when it was not built from the pinned source tree.
required_before_any_future_interval: Start from an exact clean Git revision and record its commit/tree.
Hash Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock and every Rust source consumed by the binary before build.
Record toolchain identity, build command, exit status and clean-build output binary SHA-256.
Before subprocess launch, verify the current source hashes and --binary SHA-256 against the immutable build receipt.
Reject a stale or mismatched executable before BIND or integration.
Add a negative component test proving binary/source mismatch fails before solver construction.
not_sufficient: The recovered production JSON/NPZ hashes alone
